teile.text: Instagram started as something else entirely. It was a mobile check-in app called Burbn.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the blue-eyed man in a fedora, grey suit, dark tie and gold pocket watch stands on a San Francisco street at dusk, gesturing toward a glowing city, medium shot, warm lighting.

teile.text: Burbn's founders realized it was too similar to Foursquare. So what did they change?
teile.szene: Painted urban game-poster style: two young software founders at a cluttered desk in a small San Francisco office, one frowning thoughtfully while comparing ideas with the other, medium shot, cool evening window light.

teile.text: They refocused on photo sharing, already popular with users, and renamed the app Instagram.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: a young person on a city pier photographing the harbor at sunset with a smartphone held up, close shot from the side, golden light, bold ink contours.

teile.text: The name merges instant camera and telegram. The iOS app launched October 2010.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style: a vintage instant camera beside an old telegraph key on a wooden desk, with the fedora-wearing presenter's gloved hand reaching between them, close-up, warm lamp light.

teile.text: Android launched April 2012 and passed one million downloads in under a day.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: a busy city plaza where many diverse people look down at their hands in delight, a few raising phones, wide shot, bright morning light, energetic composition.

teile.text: Facebook bought it in April 2012, and the deal closed on September 6.
teile.szene: Painted game-poster style: the fedora presenter in grey suit and dark tie shakes hands with a businessman in a glass-walled boardroom, gold pocket watch chain visible, medium shot, crisp daylight.

teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the blue-eyed fedora presenter checks his gold pocket watch on a rooftop overlooking a glowing San Francisco skyline at twilight, medium shot, calm sky above for overlays.

entwurf.beschreibung: Instagram began as Burbn, a check-in app too similar to Foursquare, before its makers refocused on photo sharing. Facebook bought it in April 2012.
